limitations: The official Wiley page was visible through the web reader, but direct local publisher HTML/PDF routes returned HTTP 403; exact publisher bytes are not pinned and the source SHA-256 is null.
This is a published conference abstract, not a full cohort report; all records are aggregate summaries only.

Methods reports 12 experiments, while the survival results use “animals”; no animal-to-experiment mapping or endpoint-specific n is stated. Outcome denominators remain null where not explicitly reported.

Mean ± SD values are reported for flow, heart rate, pH, lactate and survival, but time-bin-specific sample sizes and unit-level values are not provided. HR and lactate units are not stated in the abstract.
The reported 0–7-day pH SD of 0.49 is preserved verbatim because the abstract displays it; check publisher typography before interpreting this comparatively large dispersion.
Discontinuation-cause percentages have no explicit denominator and no declared overlap or exhaustiveness; no counts or residual category are inferred.
The publisher page lists supporting information for OC14.06 only; no OC14.07 animal table or raw-data file is listed there. This is a page-bounded finding, not a global data-absence claim.

No post-support follow-up or healthy-birth/developmental outcome is reported in this abstract. It is a distinct source report from the 2023 paper and the 2026 EP09.22 poster, but cohort overlap or follow-up is unresolved; no animal-level crosswalk is provided, so do not treat the reports as independent or pool their denominators.
Candidate status only. Scientific eligibility, exact transcription and source-byte provenance have not received human review.
